normalAttack.name: Necresta·Hella commands [Lingering Will] to attack all enemies within a single grid. Each [Lingering Will] deals (Attack *?%) Physical Damage.

ultimate.name:
Necresta·Hella channels the power of Famine to enter the [Soulscour] state for 18 seconds. During this state, her normal attack is enhanced.
Enhanced normal attack effect: Normal attack range expands to a diamond shape, and she now commands all [Lingering Will] to attack twice instead.

skill1.name: When allied Sinners deal damage, for each point of Core Damage inflicted, Necresta·Hella unleashes a special attack, commanding 1 [Lingering Will] to rapidly penetrate enemies and deal (Attack *?%) Physical Damage to all enemies in range along that direction. This effect can be triggered up to 8 times per second.

passive.name:
As Necresta·Hella suffers increasingly severe Famine infection, her abilities are enhanced based on the accumulated Resonant Mania:
30 Resonant Mania: [Lingering Will] damage increases by ?%.
60 Resonant Mania: After passive [Clamorous Lament] deals damage, it inflicts a [Phantom Core] mark on enemies with a 5-second cooldown per enemy. When a [Phantom Core] mark is removed, an additional special attack from passive [Clamorous Lament] is triggered.
90 Resonant Mania: While in the [Soulscour] state, normal attack deals 1 additional Core Damage, triggering up to once per enemy every 5 seconds.

exclusive.name: Can be used when Resonant Mania reaches maximum stacks. Necresta·Hella unleashes the power of Famine, triggering her passive [Clamorous Lament]'s special attack 8 times in the designated grid, recovers 100% HP, and enters the [Soulscour] state for 18 seconds. While in this state, her Attack Speed increases by ?%, but she cannot receive healing. When the duration ends, all Resonant Mania is depleted.
